{{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Rota |characters=ロータの町 |japanese=Rota Town |image=Rota.png |imagesize=300px |caption=A {{wp|bird's-eye view}} of Rota and Cameran Palace |region=Kanto |epicode=M08 |episode=Lucario and the Mystery of Mew |colorscheme=Emerald }} '''Rota''' (Japanese: '''ロータの町''' ''Rōta Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in northern [[Kanto]] and one of the settings of ''[[M08|Lucario and the Mystery of Mew]]''. In ancient times, Rota was an independent kingdom. As a result, the town has a medieval theme, resembling historically preserved medieval cities in Europe. Rota hosts an annual festival to decided the "Hero of the Year", which requires attendees to wear royal clothing and includes a royal ball as well as a tournament where {{pkmn|Trainer}}s engage in {{pkmn|battle}}s to see who will be the year's [[Aura|Aura Guardian]]. The tournament was entered by {{Ash}} and [[Kidd Summers]]. [[Cameran Palace]] lies north of the town, over a lake, and is connected to the town by a long bridge. It is a great medieval-style castle where [[Queen Ilene]] lives, and where [[Queen Rin]], [[Sir Aaron]], and his {{OBP|Lucario|M08}} lived in ancient times. The [[Tree of Beginning]] can be found a short distance from Rota, along with the site of the biggest battle of the century. Rota and the Tree of Beginning are located in a mountain range north of [[Pewter City]] and [[Mt.
